title: Plan provider consolidation and fetch architecture
description: Compare existing Pi web extensions, define provider/social coverage, choose reusable implementations, and produce a phased plan that preserves evidence-first output, strict cost policy, bounded fetches, SSRF protection, and deterministic offline tests.

logs.msg: Initialized ai/ context and .tasks/. Added provider landscape findings and proposed phased consolidation/fetch plan; provider capability and live smoke questions remain open.
